parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegistryNameLike
parameters.description: The name of the image repository. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: RegistryTypeNotInList
parameters.description: The types of excluded image repositories.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas page-image-registry --registry-type-in-list acr --registry-type-not-in-list quay --registry-name-like asa --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --source-ip 140.207.XXX.XXX --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas PageImageRegistry --region cn-hangzhou --RegistryTypeNotInList.1 quay --SourceIp '140.207.XXX.XXX' --PageSize 20 --RegistryNameLike asa --CurrentPage 1 --RegistryTypeInList.1 acr
